summary: The requirement document describes an online front end for a small-business lender, where applicants apply for loans on the web or a phone app, identify themselves, upload documents and sign online. The credit team reviews and approves applications with a scoring rules engine, and borrowers set up monthly EMI collection and pay overdue EMIs online. The vendor supports it for three years after go-live.
